<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/run/{id}/matrix"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns every goal's verdict and attempt count in each attack run, as columnar arrays (goals by attack runs) for heat maps. Never paginated. Accepts a login token or an API key (not a run token). Every response has a weak `ETag`: send it back as `If-None-Match` to get `304` without a body while nothing changed.
